latin: A Saturniis legibus eximuntur dei qui contentiui et perfectiui sunt; a Iouiis legibus dei Saturnii; a fatalibus legibus omnis anima uiuens intellectualiter. Legi autem Adrastiae omnia obediunt.
translation: The gods who are containing and perfecting are exempt from the Saturnian laws; the Saturnian gods are exempt from the Jovian laws; every soul living intellectually is exempt from the fated laws. But all things obey the law of Adrasteia.
translation_note: 'Adrastiae' (farmer1998:15848): Adrasteia, the Greek personification of inevitable necessity/fate; left transliterated.
